description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for managing allowlist configurations, including reading, normalizing, resolving, and editing allowlist entries for channels, accounts, and groups within a plugin SDK context.

methods.name: resolveDmGroupAllowlistConfigPaths
methods.description: Returns allowlist config paths based on scope ('dm' or 'group').

methods.name: resolveLegacyDmAllowlistConfigPaths
methods.description: Returns legacy allowlist config paths for 'dm' scope or null for 'group'.

methods.name: readConfiguredAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Converts entries to non-empty strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: collectAllowlistOverridesFromRecord
methods.description: Collects labeled allowlist overrides from a flat record.

methods.name: collectNestedAllowlistOverridesFromRecord
methods.description: Collects labeled allowlist overrides from nested records.

methods.name: createFlatAllowlistOverrideResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for flat allowlist overrides per account.

methods.name: createNestedAllowlistOverrideResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for nested hierarchical allowlist overrides per account.

methods.name: createAccountScopedAllowlistNameResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for account-scoped allowlist names based on tokens.

methods.name: buildAccountScopedAllowlistConfigEditor
methods.description: Builds an editor for modifying account-scoped allowlist configurations.

methods.name: buildAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds an adapter for account-scoped allowlist management.

methods.name: buildDmGroupAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds an adapter for managing both DM and group allowlists.

methods.name: buildLegacyDmAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds an adapter for legacy DM allowlist paths.
